💼 INTERNSHIP ALERT: Florida Blue / GuideWell — IT Summer 2027 Internship (Jacksonville, FL · Hybrid)

If you're looking for a summer 2027 internship, put this one high on your list. I've interviewed with Florida Blue before, and it's a genuinely great place to learn — real projects, a mentor on your track's team, and face time with leadership all the way up to the CIO (you present to the CIO + Tech VPs at the end of the program). The experience you can pick up here is legit.

🎯 You pick a track. A few that stand out for us:

• Infrastructure — Linux, OpenShift, and Kubernetes. If you want to be a platform engineer, this is a perfect stepping stone. OpenShift is Red Hat's platform, so this track lines up directly if your goal is somewhere like IBM or Red Hat down the road. Most people in the club could do really well here.

• Cybersecurity — work alongside real red-team and blue-team members on actual security challenges. Security+/Network+/A+/Linux+ (done or in progress) is preferred. If security is your thing, tap in.

• Also offered: Generative AI, Cloud Engineering (AWS/Azure), Data Analytics, Data Science, Application Development, and Business Analyst.

📋 The basics:
• Location: Jacksonville, FL (Hybrid)
• Pay: $24–$38/hr
• GPA 3.0+, able to commit ~30 hrs/week
• Open to juniors, seniors, and grad students (there's a separate Graduate IT Internship posting too — grab that one if you're in a master's program)
• Job ID: 42181 · posted 10/07

🔗 Apply: https://fa-etum-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/floridablue/job/42181
🔗 Apply: https://fa-etum-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/floridablue/job/42182?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=jobboard
Apply early, and come find me if you want help picking a track or want your resume looked at before you submit. Let's get some people in. 🦉

💻 Job Opening: SSERCA Student Web Developer @ FAU Research Computing
FAU's Research Computing (OIT) is hiring a Student Web Developer, 20 hrs/week, $15/hr, on the Boca campus. Apply by Oct 3!
🔗 https://fau.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/FAU/details/SSERCA-Student-Web-Developer_REQ22952

What you'd do: build and maintain the SSERCA website and web apps, add features, work with forms/databases/APIs, and handle responsive design + accessibility, working directly with the Assistant Director of Research Computing Systems.

Why it's worth it: SSERCA is the alliance behind advanced computing, AI, data science, and cybersecurity across FL universities. It's web dev to start, but it gets your foot in the door with the team that runs FAU's research computing, so over time (especially if it grows into something bigger) you'd be around Kubernetes, Linux, and AI cluster management.

Requirements: enrolled FAU undergrad, 6+ credit hours (12 if international), 2.0+ GPA. CS/IT/CompE/Data Science preferred; Git experience is a plus.
❓ Questions? Email James Mauser (jmauser@fau.edu).
